gap: On a page left open overnight, Complete All with its box reading UNCHECKED also completes the next occurrence that the screen still shows as tomorrow's, then creates the one after it. SEED (desktop 1200x800, America/New_York, clock Tue 2026-03-10 21:00, lists as in recur-check): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Water plants',project:'p_house',when:'2026-03-10',repeat:{mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'day'}},{id:'t2',title:'Fix door',project:'p_house'}], route #/project/p_house. STEPS: (1) Tue 21:00: click t1's row checkbox. Storage is correct: t1 [x] and a new open 'Water plants' for 2026-03-11 (W). (2) Leave the page open until Wed 2026-03-11 08:00, with no reload and no other input (page.clock.setFixedTime). The screen is still Tuesday's: '[x] Water plants', '[ ] Mar 11 Water plants', '[ ] Fix door'. The box reads unchecked because Fix door is open. (3) Click Complete All to finish Fix door. EXPECTED (CONTRACT, Repeating to-dos): an open occurrence that completing one of the list's to-dos created counts with that one 'while its date is still to come', and 'Completing all leaves such an occurrence alone, since it already counts as done with the one before it'. The contract adds: ''Its date is still to come' is judged on the day on screen ... a press remembers the day that was on screen when it began', and such a click 'never completes the new day's occurrence'. On the day on screen (Tue), W is still to come, so the click should complete only Fix door. The same click on Tuesday evening does exactly that (CONTROL: W stays open and no Mar 12 occurrence is created). ACTUAL (6/6 across two clean runs, each run testing the toolbar box, the project header's List actions > Complete All and the phone 390px list menu > Complete All; heading menu also seen; no page errors): W is marked [x] with completedAt Wed 08:00. Nobody watered on Wednesday, yet the occurrence is logged as done and Wednesday's open to-do is gone. A new open 'Water plants' for 2026-03-12 (occurrence 3) is created. Final storage: [x] Mar 10, [x] Mar 11, [ ] Mar 12, [x] Fix door. CAUSE: store.toggleAll judges the direction on seenDay() (Tue), but setCompleted(ids,true) computes spawnedAhead(items) with todayISO() (Wed), so W no longer counts as ahead. The toggleAll comment even says 'Completing judges still to come on today'. r7's fix covered only the checked-box case, and recur-check's overnightCompleteAll wrongly assumes an unchecked box means the page followed the new day. Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pr-Desktop-dev-Todo/7de92c54-84d7-47b2-acf0-63c627b2ff05/scratchpad/recur-r8-c3/repro-overnight-complete-all-unchecked.mjs (prints REPRODUCED 6/6 plus the control). Also tried, no break found: 24 two-tab random UI fuzz runs of 60 steps each (ticks, double-clicks, deletes, Clear completed, Complete All, project and heading menus, Delete Heading, Move, stop repeating, card typing ending with Escape, click outside, card box or Cmd+K, reloads, day changes), checked after every step for one open repeating occurrence per series, unique occurrence numbers, nextId consistency, ends.after and page errors: all clean. Double-click and double-tap on a box in Active are guarded. Seen, not claimed: a double-click on the x of a completed occurrence also deletes the next occurrence inserted right under it, which ends the series; the contract's double-click rule covers only boxes.
why: Overnight, Complete All with its box reading unchecked also completes the next occurrence the screen still shows as tomorrow's, logging it as done and creating the one after (contract: completing all leaves such an occurrence alone; still-to-come is judged on the day on screen)
